title: UPSC NDA & NA II 2026 Answer Key Released
postName: National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026
vacancyDetails: Total 394 vacancies across Army, Navy, Air Force and Naval Academy for NDA & NA II 2026.
qualification: Candidates must have passed 10+2 or equivalent from a recognized board. Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics are required for Air Force and Naval Academy entries.
ageLimit: Age limit as notified by UPSC for NDA & NA II 2026. Generally, candidates must be between 16.5 and 19.5 years as on the date specified in the official notification.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS: Rs. 100; SC / ST / female candidates: Nil. Fee payment through online mode as per UPSC rules.
selectionProcess: Written examination → SSB interview → Document verification → Medical examination → Final selection
documentsRequired: Admit card, valid photo ID, OTR registration details, educational certificates, and other supporting documents as required in the next stages.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official UPSC portal.
2. Complete or log in to One Time Registration (OTR).
3. Fill the NDA & NA II 2026 application form.
4. Upload documents and photograph as required.
5. Pay the fee and submit the application.
6. Save the confirmation page and print the form.
shortDescription: UPSC has released the provisional answer key for NDA & NA II 2026. Candidates can check the official answer keys and objection window on the UPSC portal.
content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the provisional answer key for the National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026.

The written exam for NDA & NA II 2026 was held on 13 September 2026. Candidates can access the official answer key for the relevant sets and challenge objections, if applicable, within the scheduled window.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 20 May 2026
  • Last date to apply online: 11 June 2026
  • Exam date: 13 September 2026
  • Admit card available: 03 September 2026
  • Answer key available: 17 September 2026

Vacancy details

Total vacancies: 394 posts

  • Army: 208
  • Navy: 42
  • Air Force: 120
  • Naval Academy: 24

Answer key

The official answer key is published on the UPSC website. Candidates should compare their responses and take note of the objection procedure if applicable.
